title: LongForcing: Scaling Temporal Manifold Matching for Long-Horizon World Rollout
title_zh: LongForcing：为长时域世界模拟扩展时间流形匹配方法

paragraphs.en: LongForcing 是一种为长时域世界模拟扩展时间流形匹配方法的蒸馏技术，显著提升了文本到视频生成和交互式动作条件世界模型的质量。 Autoregressive video diffusion models have emerged as a foundation for long-horizon world rollout. However, when extended far beyond their training windows, these models suffer from progressive drift: visual quality deteriorates, motion becomes inconsistent, and object identity gradually collapses as generated frames are recursively reused as context. We study a supervision-horizon gap: short-horizon distillation leaves later rollout states without direct supervision. We show that matching short-window marginals need not determine long-horizon behavior, while longer on-policy trajectories expose delayed failures to training. This motivates temporal manifold matching at scale for long-horizon world models. Building on this insight, we introduce LongForcing, a distillation approach that scales teacher supervision to long student self-rollouts. LongForcing preserves the short-horizon teacher-forcing and causal ODE-distillation stages, while replacing the realscore teacher in the final distribution-matching stage with an extended-horizon bidirectional teacher. The long-horizon teacher supervises extended student self-rollouts using the standard distribution-matching formulation, without modifying the student architecture or increasing inference cost. We evaluate LongForcing on text-to-video generation and interactive action-conditioned world models, achieving a VBench Quality score of 85.52 and improving WorldRoamBench 60s action score by 23.9 points in first-person ablations. Qualitative stress tests further sample interactive rollouts up to 24 hours, far beyond the training horizon. These results suggest that scaling supervision along the temporal axis is a practical step toward long-horizon world models. The project website and code are at https://github.com/Fantasy-AMAP/LongForcing.
paragraphs.zh: LongForcing 是一种蒸馏技术，用于为长时域世界模拟扩展时间流形匹配方法，显著提升了文本到视频生成和交互式动作条件世界模型的质量。自回归视频扩散模型已成为长时域世界展开的基础。 然而，当这些模型被扩展到远超其训练窗口时，会出现渐进式漂移：视觉质量下降，运动变得不一致，且由于生成的帧被递归地重复用作上下文，物体身份会逐渐崩溃。 我们研究了一个监督时域鸿沟：短时域蒸馏导致后续展开状态缺乏直接监督。 我们发现，匹配短时域边缘分布并不必然决定长时域行为，而更长的在线策略轨迹则能暴露延迟出现的失败问题。 这促使我们针对长时域世界模型进行大规模的时间流形匹配研究。 基于这一见解，我们提出了 LongForcing，一种蒸馏方法，可将教师模型的监督扩展至学生的长时域自展开过程。 LongForcing 保留了短时域的教师强制和因果 ODE 蒸馏阶段，同时将最终分布匹配阶段中的 realscore 教师模型替换为扩展时域的双向教师模型。 长时域教师模型使用标准的分布匹配公式对扩展后的学生自展开过程进行监督，而无需修改学生模型架构或增加推理成本。 我们在文本到视频生成和交互式动作条件世界模型上评估了 LongForcing，获得了 85.52 的 VBench 质量分数，并在第一人称消融实验中使 WorldRoamBench 60 秒动作得分提升了 23.9 分。 定性压力测试进一步对交互式展开过程进行了采样，时长最长可达 24 小时，远超训练时域。 这些结果表明，沿时间轴扩展监督范围是迈向长时域世界模型的一个实用步骤。 项目网站和代码请访问 https://github.com/Fantasy-AMAP/LongForcing。
